targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-859 (targeted short-budget diagnostic, per chip-20260801-arc062-851-diagnostic, isolating whether modulatory_channel_route_source causes V3-EXQ-851's MECH-448/449 collapse): SAME seeds as 851 (42/43/44), ablating route_source ('lateral_pfc' vs 'none') at a short ~45min budget, tracking only MECH-448/449 engagement. Result: NEITHER mechanism discriminates by route_source -- MECH-448 is alive in BOTH arms (3/3 seeds each), MECH-449 is dead in BOTH arms (0/3 seeds each). This does NOT reproduce 851's own finding (MECH-448 specifically dead under lateral_pfc, alive under the analogous route in 654j) -- at short budget, MECH-448 is alive regardless of route_source, and MECH-449 is dead regardless of route_source. Two readings are live and NOT distinguished by this run: (a) route_source genuinely has no causal effect on MECH-448/449, and 851's finding has some OTHER explanation entirely (making 851's own diagnosis wrong); or (b) route_source's suppressive effect on MECH-448 is training-duration-dependent and only emerges over a longer run, which this short probe cannot detect by construction. claim_ids=[] correctly -- this run cannot support or weaken MECH-309/ARC-062 either way. Self-route (mixed_partial_result_needs_full_replication) is well-calibrated and should stand: the honest read is inconclusive, not a discrimination in either direction. The suspended V3-EXQ-858 allocation (ARC-062 Leg P-B, which presupposes MECH-448/449 are active under the lateral_pfc-routed matched-stack config) should REMAIN SUSPENDED -- this run neither confirms nor refutes that presupposition. Recommend a full-training-budget version of THIS SAME ablation (lateral_pfc vs none, same seeds, full duration matching 851's ~7.7h) as the only design that can actually discriminate reading (a) from (b), while flagging the compute cost tradeoff for governance to weigh given V3-EXQ-858 is already sitting suspended on this exact question.
learning_extracted: A cheap short-budget probe designed to isolate a causal factor found in a full-length run can fail to reproduce the original finding at all -- this is itself informative (the effect may be training-duration-dependent) but does NOT mean the original finding was spurious. Scaling down duration is not always a safe cost-reduction for reproducing a training-dynamics-dependent effect.

MECH-449 being dead in BOTH arms of this short probe (matching its deadness in 851's full run) suggests MECH-449's suppression is NOT route_source-dependent at all -- it may need more training exposure to engage regardless of routing, a distinct question from MECH-448's route-dependent-looking collapse.

A suspended downstream allocation (V3-EXQ-858) that presupposes a config property should stay suspended when a diagnostic returns genuinely inconclusive, rather than being unblocked on an ambiguous result.

The self-route's own honest 'needs_full_replication' label, rather than forcing a false discrimination either way, is the correct calibration here -- concur rather than push toward a stronger reading than the data supports.
